notes.title: Minor fixes - and a new demo!
notes.notes: Some minor fixes to the Witchcraft content -- but also, we have a new demo of the game!

notes.title: It must be witchcraft...
notes.notes:
Here's a note from Verity's journal, describing what she's discovered in the new build:

[i]Spooky going's on here at school. That poppet doll looks interesting. And the owl seems to want me to do something, though I really don't know if it's a good idea or not...[/i]

Who will rise? And who will fall?
A few minor font size fixes to make the game more playable on Deck!

notes.title: 1.1.8 - Minor fixes
notes.notes: Minor story fixes, a few more routes to unlocking some important information, and a new way to knock someone out. Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.1.3 - this time, with achievements!
notes.notes: Two updates in quick succession? Quite an achievement! ... in this case, they're working again.

Good morning, students! This is a minor update to fix a few small inconsistencies and soft-locks.

Thanks to everyone who reported issues. Enjoy!

notes.title: It's time to get EXPELLED!
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.polygon.com/gaming/537355/expelled-review-inkle-overboard-narrative-mystery-game]Polygon[/url] say "Expelled! is the most fun you can have being accused of attempted murder." [url=https://www.theguardian.com/games/2025/mar/12/expelled-review-turning-the-tables-on-the-private-school-class-hierarchy-inkle]The Guardian[/url] says "It’s worth persevering to uncover all of the school’s intimate secrets." [url=https://www.eurogamer.net/expelled-an-overboard-game-review]Eurogamer[/url] says "It's a cause for celebration." 

Expelled! is a follow-up to 2021's BAFTA-winning youdunnit Overboard! 

It's packed full of wild character, mysteries, surprises and secrets. Can you avoid being expelled? What does your roommate have under the bed? And what's in the cellar?!?

Why not avoid spoilers and play today?

notes.title: Expelled! TRAILER Revealed!
notes.notes:
Prepare yourself for blackmail, mayhem and manipulation with the next game in the Overboard! franchise, launching [b]March 12th[/b].

[previewyoutube=OzUjGieWQIY;full]Watch the trailer now![/previewyoutube]

It's 1922, and Verity Amersham is about to be [b]EXPELLED[/b] from Miss Mulligatawney's School - unless she can find someone to take the fall for a terrible attack on a School Prefect. 

Lie, cheat, steal - but don't get caught!

With a cast of wild characters to investigate, leads, danger, secrets and surprises, Miss Mulligatawney's School promises a mystery with a wicked twist. Wishlist now!

notes.title: The next game from Heaven's Vault studio Inkle is about a 1920s school for girls
notes.notes: Inkle's next game seems to be set in, or focused on, a boarding school for young girls in 1922. The tenatively-named Miss Mulligatawney's School for Promising Girls doesn't have many details yet but it's what they're working on after releasing A Highland Song late last year. The short descriptions available so far focus on a setting in an old nunnery, and details in the background of images seem to imply that there'll be some foul play—you know, like someone falling off a tall tower... Read more.
